paragraphs: Nash (נש). Abba Shaul bar Nash (אבא שאול בר נש), Niddah 25b.[^1][^2]

notes.text: נש is retained as Nash; this notice does not settle whether it is a personal name or the Aramaic word for a person.
Niddah 25b follows כה: under the folio convention; no edition-specific citation has been independently checked.
